title: What's This Tiny Hole in a Padlock For?
description:
What's the tiny hole at the bottom of a padlock for? It isn't a keyhole. Padlocks live outdoors, and rain sneaks in around the shackle. Without a way out, trapped water rusts the parts inside, and in winter it freezes and jams the lock solid. That's why many padlocks have a tiny hole at the bottom: it's a drain. Gravity pulls the water out before it can rust or freeze.

Ever noticed the hole on your padlock?

More true whys: https://www.youtube.com/@truewhys?sub_confirmation=1

Sources: House Digest, "What Is The Tiny Hole On The Bottom Of A Padlock For?"; Monroe Engineering, "Why Padlocks Have a Small Hole on the Bottom".
Animation, music and sound: TrueWhys (original). 3D people made with MPFB / MakeHuman (CC0). Fonts: Lilita One (Open Font License).
